title: Tedious

Matching Story follows the familiar pattern of titles like Royal Kingdom but without the variety or thoughtful design. After a while, it becomes exhausting, breaking toolboxes, only to reveal more toolboxes, all so you can spawn something that creates ice fields, which take two strikes to clear. If not ice, then you’re made to turn the field green. And because the game has no ads, (thankfully) it’s obvious they rely on coins spending to continue and power ups. Some level levels feel intentionally unwinnable without them. Even the power ups received at the start of a game for winning a previous level are intentionally placed in the least helpful spots. Always. During play, I’ve seen potential power up matches disappear before my eyes for no reason. There are simply better designed gameplay apps out there.

author: Slot Player 202312345
title: Fun, but…
content: I really am enjoying this game, especially the farm land merge part.  Playing the matching game is super frustrating in that if you run out of moves, it costs 900 diamonds and when you win, you win 24 or less.. This is very lopsided and takes away some of the fun knowing that if you lose, you either cough up real money or you stop playing.  (update:  this game is not about a shivering girl… you get to play that part as a bonus of the match game.  Don’t expect to see this much, it happens very rarely.  Lastly, this is modified version of candy crush, it is a symbol match game and not what the videos show you.  If you like candy crush, you’ll like this game).  The levels get progressively harder and you will eventually run out of lives and either have to buy them or beg on the boards.  Update:  (leaving the game rating the same).  Found out a few things while playing this game.  First and foremost, the “frozen girl” lead in is a gimmick to pull you in and it is NOT a part of this game.  It is a side game only and while you can get some purple diamonds, the side game only shows up every 100 levels and the after a few hundred games, this disappears completely.  A good “bait and switch” tactic.  So you only get bonus games (for purple diamonds) every hundred levels.  Every 10 levels you get the “Super Hard” level, requiring you to use purple diamonds or play 20-50 games to get the game to give you a win.  Tons of extra side games, all of them time-bound to create that competition within the game.  Most of these games are losers so take that with a grain of salt.  First play of the day gives you a timer for lives (unlimited lives) for a specific amount of time.  Take advantage of this and work to advance.  The island part is fun, but takes a very long time to advance.  You need hundreds of the same item to advance to the next level of items.  There are only 3 free islands and the game is pretty much over at level 5100 (so far).  Tons of items for sale, ranging from $.99 cents to buying a whole island for $19.99 or less.  They have EXCELLENT customer service, but no “how to play” documentation.  In order to use the FAQ section, you need to be familiar with what everything is called or otherwise you won’t find anything.  I will play this one out and then move on.
